description:
One cannot escape from this lewd and sweet confinement! Ga-hyun, a secretary harboring a secret crush on Director Jung Tae-rim - a member of an organized crime syndicate - throws her body in front of a dump truck to save him.    

“Did you jump in front of the car to save me?”    

“You were almost hit...”   

“Are you out of your mind? You threw yourself in front of a car?”    

“...”    

“Look at yourself, Song Ga-hyun. It would have been better if I were the one hit. How could you be so reckless with that frail body of yours?”    

Director Jung Tae-rim, who had always been cold and stoic, begins to obsessively nurse and dote on the injured Ga-hyun...

[Original Webtoon](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13956614)
